name_note: The GTDB genus matches the published genus Limosilactobacillus, but GTDB divides the published species Limosilactobacillus reuteri into several separate species with letter suffixes.

sentences.text: A core-genome phylogenomic analysis of Limosilactobacillus reuteri identified eight lineages, four of them represented by isolates from intestinal digesta or faeces of rodents and primates.
On that basis one new species, Limosilactobacillus secundus, and three new subspecies of L. reuteri were proposed.
A genome-wide association study reported that Limosilactobacillus reuteri was among the Lactobacillaceae species showing the highest degrees of host specialization.

A systematic review and meta-analysis of six randomized trials evaluated Limosilactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938 for treating acute gastroenteritis in children, with duration of diarrhoea as primary outcome.
